text:
This rich molten lava cake features a decadent, gooey chocolate center encased in a delicate sponge.
Prep: 15 min | Cook: 10 min

Steps:
1. Preheat your oven to 200 degrees Celsius and grease two ramekins with a little cooking oil.
2. Melt the 100 grams of dark chocolate and 80 grams of unsalted butter together over a double boiler until smooth.
3. In a separate bowl, whisk the 2 eggs and 30 grams of castor sugar until the mixture is pale and slightly thickened.
4. Slowly fold the melted chocolate mixture into the egg mixture until well combined.
5. Sift in the 36 grams of cake flour and 10 grams of cocoa powder, stirring gently until no dry streaks remain.
6. Pour the batter into the prepared ramekins, filling them about three-quarters full.
7. Bake in the center of the oven for 8 to 10 minutes until the sides are firm but the center remains soft to the touch.
8. Let the cakes rest for 2 minutes before carefully inverting them onto plates to serve warm.

Tips:
- Do not overbake, as the center needs to stay liquid.
- Ensure the ramekins are thoroughly greased so the cakes release easily.
- Serve immediately while the center is still warm and flowy.

Notes: You may add a pinch of salt to the batter to enhance the chocolate flavor.
